mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP and S&P 500 returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 1% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, stimulating economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 1%, or the response of S&P 500 returns to changes in the federal funds rate is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 10% indicates a weakening labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when the unemployment rate is above 10%, or the correlation between the unemployment rate and S&P 500 returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of industrial production growth, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP and consumer price index (CPI) indicates the overall health of the economy, with a strong GDP and low CPI leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when GDP is strong and CPI is low, or the interaction between GDP and CPI is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the unemployment rate indicates the overall monetary policy stance, with a low federal funds rate and high unemployment rate leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when the federal funds rate is low and unemployment rate is high, or the interaction between the federal funds rate and unemployment rate is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in payroll employment indicates a weakening labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when payroll employment is decreasing, or the response of S&P 500 returns to changes in payroll employment is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between housing starts and retail sales indicates the overall health of the consumer sector, with strong housing starts and high retail sales leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when housing starts are strong and retail sales are high, or the interaction between housing starts and retail sales is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
